correctness.rationale: Directly reconstruct each coordinate residue coset with its minimum-absolute representative; membership in each finite absolute ideal section is equivalent to the centered representative being inside. For U_n the exact CDF P(U_n<=t)=min(1,(2t+1)/n) gives stochastic increase in n, so independent monotone quantile coupling proves D_r/r^k >= D_s/s^k. If section lacks a point of centered box B_s, take one of minimal nonnegative coordinate sum, with predecessor inside; condition on other coordinates at the missing vector, which has positive s-law probability, and replace coordinate distributions one by one to get strict gap. Equality iff each nonempty section contains B_s. Basis-coordinate q_j multipliers and k=1 through d are preserved; skew subgroups are excluded. Provided verifier checks 2080 finite direct/centered formulas but is not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: All-rank result requires absolute ideals and coordinate subgroup, not general convex bodies and skew lattices.
